answer_2.quote: We assess the performance using four key metrics: accuracy (ACC), attack success rate (ASR), modification success rate (MSR) and detection rate.

answer_3.quote: we evaluated the detection rates of SEED-generated solutions against baseline methods using GPT-4o to simulate human detection following the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a comprehensive human evaluation study with 20 PhD students in computer science ... each evaluator independently assessed 10 solutions ... spend no more than 10 seconds on each solution, emphasizing the coherence of the Chain of Thought (CoT) rather than the correctness.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators assess the coherence of the reasoning chain within a 10‑second time limit.
